scope: Isolated physical qualification of dimensional viscosity/traction; no production/performance/history changes. Preserve every earlier result.

materials.coupled_material: nu=.001, mu=1Pa s isothermal Newtonian model liquid; waterlike nu=.000001 evaluated separately, not interchanged to pass quietness.

operator_model.old: Central pair strain approximation; omitted neighbours, h=4dx; reproduce old slab errors.
operator_model.candidate: Corrected first-order least-squares velocity gradient G; symmetric strain D; dissipation functional R=mu sum V D:D; force=-dR/dv=-2mu G^T V sym(Gv). No fitted damping.
operator_model.support: h_visc=2dx; compare fixed support ratios only to isolate quadrature, not fit material nu.
operator_model.boundary: Natural traction at free surfaces; solid mirror velocity even tangential/odd normal for free-slip, odd all components for no-slip. Ghost samples enter gradient support, not fluid mass/energy quadrature. Forces use exact adjoint including ghost mappings.
operator_model.invariants: Rigid translations/rotations cost zero strain for unconstrained fluid; pair-adjoint forces have zero total internal linear and angular impulse. Solid reaction accounted explicitly. Rank-deficient/ill-conditioned gradients are rejected, not pseudoinverted into a thin-film model.

reference_cases.horizontal_shear: u_x=U sin(2pi*z/L), uniform y; periodic x,z and natural/free-slip y; amplitude exp(-nu*k^2*t), independent H.
reference_cases.vertical_shear: u_x=U cos(pi*y/H) for free-slip/free-slip; sin(pi*y/H) for no-slip/no-slip; sin(pi*y/(2H)) for no-slip/free-surface. Same analytic diffusion eigenmodes.
reference_cases.resolution: Fixed L=.2,H=.05 m for viscosity tests, n_y=2,4,8,12,16,24; horizontal cells L/dx, dx=H/n_y; native/full matrix test may reduce exact Fourier symmetries but must retain boundary profile and cross-component couplings.
reference_cases.tractions: Compare integrated stationary-wall force with analytic mu*A*[du/dy(top)-du/dy(bottom)], and virtual-work/energy balance; no fluid momentum conservation demanded where walls exert traction.
reference_cases.quietness: Retain original K<=.00125 J/kg at5..6s as LEGACY screen; independently calculate modal decay time and threshold crossing for specified nu,U,H,BC. Any replacement applies only to reference-controlled regimes and never erases original FAIL.

criteria.convergence: Errors decrease with fixed-geometry spatial refinement; two finest tested endpoints pass. Half dt and additional pressure iterations preserve the physical assessment.

sequence: First validate operator/traction/conservation on fixed positions, regular and controlled disorder. Full PBF only after relevant operator regime passes; then coupled shear decay, hydrostatics and a bounded collision control where possible. Never infer collision quiescence from an unrelated shear mode.
retention: New durable directory; immutable requests/protocol supplements, source identities, native/raw operator observations and full scheduled PBF states plus every-step energy ledgers; compressed/raw SHA256 readback, fsync and second primary-PC home copy. No /tmp canonical archive.
